raw_response:
I will do it much like I did before, because this land is not new to me. I have only 6 mu and I work it myself, so I cannot make it too fancy. I will follow the wheat-maize rotation on all 6 mu. For wheat, I will still use improved seed because I have seen the better kinds stand more evenly and fill better than the old ones. I will put the base fertilizer a little heavier than light, because if wheat is short of fertilizer, the ears come out weak and that loss hurts more than wasting a little fertilizer. I have well water, so I will water when the crop really needs it. For maize, I will also use hybrid seed, same as many people around me do now, because it gives a steadier harvest. I will keep fertilizer close to what worked last year, not cut too much, and I will spray when I see the need. I do not like gambling with yield. If I spend a bit more on fertilizer and seed, I will save labor elsewhere and keep the field clean and timely.
